subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Sun Aug 9 shortlist | Q2 earnings wave — TEAM & ABNB lead 9 candidates
html_body:
Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Sunday, August 9, 2026 — Kuwait time

9 candidates cleared all gates

Q2 earnings season is the whole story this week — a genuine wave of beat-and-raise gaps across mega/large caps (TEAM +35.7%, ABNB +17.5% fresh Friday), plus a few small-cap continuations still confirming on IBKR. Sector-agnostic scan, no binary catalysts, no defense names.

⚠️ Account snapshot (live IBKR, checked for this run)

$431.56 available cash — lower than the $542.01 in portfolio.json/CLAUDE.md, because that file is stale (last updated Aug 5). Since then the GOOG buy filled (0.3 sh @ $368.16 avg, now $353.65, unrealized −$4.35), and two GTC buy limits from Aug 4 are still open/unfilled: AXTI 2 sh @ $58, SPXC 0.5 sh @ $200 (~$216 combined). Sizing below uses the real $431.56 figure, not the stale one.
Separately: the open GOOG position currently has no stop-limit order on the book (only a stale REPLACED sell-limit at $408, no protective stop). Worth fixing independent of this scan — same gap pattern as CAPR/IQV.

🎯 Momentum Shortlist

~35 raw tickers surfaced across 27 web searches + IBKR theme/price checks. 9 cleared all 4 gates and IBKR live-price confirmation. Cap mix: 5 large/mega, 1 mid, 3 small — genuinely large-cap-heavy this week (earnings season), noted explicitly per the cap-balance rule rather than padded with weak small-caps. Run stock-analyzer on any name for the full deep dive before entering.
#1 — TEAM Atlassian Corp
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5) Software LARGE CAP		 $149.50 +35.70%

Signal: Q4 FY26 beat-and-raise reported after close Thu Aug 6 — gapped from $110.17 close straight to $145.64 open, ran to $153.20 intraday, closed $149.07 Fri Aug 7. Fresh, 1 trading day old.

Why it's interesting: Clean beat-and-raise, still 18.7% below its $184.00 52-week high — meaning there's real room left even after a 35% single-day pop, unlike names already pinned at their ceiling. $762M avg daily $ volume — exit liquidity is a non-issue.

Realistic target: +5-10% over 3-6 trading days — post-earnings drift into the pre-184 resistance shelf.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $143–145 — Friday closed off the day's $153.20 high; don't chase the gap.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $144.00 · stop-limit trigger $140.50 / limit $139.80 (below Fri's $141.51 session low) · TP1 sell limit $155.00 · TP2 $165.00 · size ~0.45 sh ≈ $64.80 (15% of $431.56) · R:R ≈ 2.6:1

Event window: Earnings already behind it ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — enterprise software (Jira/Confluence)  |  Defense: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze TEAM
#2 — ABNB Airbnb Inc
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5) Travel LARGE CAP		 $178.10 +17.45%

Signal: Earnings beat reported after close Thu Aug 6 — gapped from $151.64 to $164.79 open, ran to a fresh $178.48 52-week high, closed $178.07 right at the high. 1 trading day old.

Why it's interesting: Textbook post-earnings gap-and-hold — closed at the session high with no fade, on $706M avg daily volume. Downside: it's now pinned right at its 52-week high with essentially zero overhead resistance data to lean on, so this is a "let it prove itself" name, not a chase.

Realistic target: +8-11% over 5-8 trading days if the breakout holds above the gap.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $165–168 (the gap-open zone) — Friday's close was already up 17% on the day, chasing here has no margin.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $166.00 · stop-limit trigger $162.50 / limit $161.80 (below Fri's $163.45 gap-day low) · TP1 sell limit $185.00 · TP2 $195.00 · size ~0.39 sh ≈ $64.74 (15% of $431.56) · R:R ≈ 4.6:1

Event window: Earnings already behind it ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — short-term rental/travel platform  |  Defense: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze ABNB
#3 — CRDO Credo Technology
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5) AI Semiconductor MID CAP		 $249.99 +8.49%

Signal: Multi-day AI-connectivity breakout — up 9% Aug 4, then another +8.49% Fri Aug 7 closing $249.99 near the day's $250.00 high. Fresh leg today, up 52% YTD.

Why it's interesting: AI/hyperscaler data-center connectivity name riding the same capex wave as the broader semiconductor complex, confirmed by huge liquidity ($2.0B avg $ volume). Still 19% below its $308.67 52-week high — real room, not extended into a ceiling.

Realistic target: +10-17% over 5-10 trading days toward the $265-280 zone.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $238–240 — today's two-day gain (+18% combined) is too hot to chase at the close.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $239.00 · stop-limit trigger $230.00 / limit $228.50 (below Fri's $231.25 session low) · TP1 sell limit $265.00 · TP2 $280.00 · size ~0.27 sh ≈ $64.53 (15% of $431.56) · R:R ≈ 2.5:1

Event window: No dated catalyst ahead — pure technical breakout ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — semiconductor connectivity hardware  |  Defense: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze CRDO
#4 — IBTA Ibotta Inc
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5) Ad-tech / Rewards SMALL/MID CAP		 $38.42 +6.84%

Signal: Q2 revenue beat ($88.9M vs $84.97M est.) reported Aug 3, still confirming 4 trading days later — up another 6.84% Fri Aug 7, hit a fresh $39.91 intraday high before closing $38.42.

Why it's interesting: CPG rewards/advertising network still grinding higher four sessions after the print — persistence beyond day 1 is the tell that this isn't a one-day pop. Only 4% below its $40.00 52-week high.

Realistic target: +7-18% over 5-8 trading days on a break of the 52-week high.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $37.00–37.50 — Friday faded off its $39.91 high into the close.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $37.30 · stop-limit trigger $35.50 / limit $35.00 (below Thu's $35.96 close/shelf) · TP1 sell limit $40.00 · TP2 $44.00 · size ~1.73 sh ≈ $64.53 (15% of $431.56) · R:R ≈ 1.2:1 to TP1 (tight — treat as a scale point), ≈2.9:1 to TP2

Event window: Earnings already behind it ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — CPG rewards/ad network, not gambling or lending  |  Defense: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze IBTA
#5 — SNOW Snowflake Inc
⭐⭐⭐ (3/5) Cloud/Data Software LARGE CAP		 $330.08 +3.80%

Signal: Grinding relative-strength leader, up 21.7% over the past month, printed a fresh $331.40 all-time high Fri Aug 7 on continued volume.

Why it's interesting: Clean uptrend with no single-day gap to fade — this is sustained RS leadership, not an earnings pop. $2.5B avg $ volume, no liquidity concern at any size.

Realistic target: +6-11% over 5-8 trading days, blue-sky breakout with no overhead resistance.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET ~$328–330 — this is a continuation breakout at all-time highs, not a chase off a single-day spike.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $329.00 · stop-limit trigger $321.50 / limit $320.80 (below Fri's $322.13 session low) · TP1 sell limit $350.00 · TP2 $365.00 · size ~0.20 sh ≈ $65.80 (15% of $431.56) · R:R ≈ 3.0:1

Event window: No dated catalyst ahead — pure RS breakout ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — cloud data platform software  |  Defense: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze SNOW
#6 — ZBRA Zebra Technologies
⭐⭐⭐ (3/5) Enterprise Hardware LARGE CAP		 $380.18 +4.38%

Signal: Up 39.4% over the past month, printed a fresh $383.63 all-time high Fri Aug 7 before pulling back slightly into the $376.49 close.

Why it's interesting: Enterprise scanning/tracking hardware name at a genuine breakout with clear RS leadership. $387M avg $ volume.

Realistic target: +6-10% over 5-8 trading days.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $372–375 — Friday's high faded into the close, let it settle before entering.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $373.00 · stop-limit trigger $364.00 / limit $363.00 (below Fri's $365.49 session low) · TP1 sell limit $395.00 · TP2 $410.00 · size ~0.17 sh ≈ $63.41 (15% of $431.56) · R:R ≈ 2.2:1

Event window: No dated catalyst ahead ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — barcode/enterprise scanning hardware  |  Defense: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze ZBRA
#7 — INTC Intel Corp
⭐⭐⭐ (3/5) Semiconductors MEGA CAP		 $101.69 +1.88%

Signal: Q2 beat (Data Center/AI/Foundry growth) reported Aug 4, up 10.8% that day and still confirming with another +1.88% Fri Aug 7 — 3 trading days old, momentum intact.

Why it's interesting: Turnaround story with the earnings risk already resolved. $12.6B avg $ volume — total non-issue on liquidity. Still 29% below its $142.35 52-week high, giving real room before any overhead resistance.

Realistic target: +8-14% over 5-10 trading days toward the $110-116 shelf (mid-July swing highs).

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET ~$101.69 — healthy range today, not extended.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $102.00 · stop-limit trigger $97.50 / limit $96.80 (below Fri's $98.03 session low) · TP1 sell limit $110.00 · TP2 $116.00 · size ~0.64 sh ≈ $65.28 (15% of $431.56) · R:R ≈ 1.7:1

Event window: Earnings already behind it ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — semiconductor manufacturer  |  Defense: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze INTC
#8 — INFU InfuSystem Holdings
⭐⭐⭐ (3/5) Healthcare Services SMALL CAP		 $12.49 +5.22%

Signal: Q2 beat reported Aug 4 ($0.15 EPS vs $0.11 est., record oncology revenue), still confirming — closed at the session high Fri Aug 7, up another 5.22% that day. 3 trading days old.

Why it's interesting: Infusion pump rental/reprocessing for oncology and wound care. Closed exactly at the day's high with no fade — strong hands. Only 3.8% below its $12.97 52-week high.

Realistic target: +8-16% over 5-8 trading days on a break above the 52-week high.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $12.00–12.10 — don't chase the close-at-high print; R:R at $12.49 is too thin against a sane stop.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $12.05 · stop-limit trigger $11.45 / limit $11.30 (below Fri's $11.58 session low) · TP1 sell limit $12.97 · TP2 $14.00 · size ~5.37 sh ≈ $64.71 (15% of $431.56) · R:R ≈ 1.2:1 to TP1, ≈2.6:1 to TP2

Event window: Earnings already behind it ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — medical device rental services  |  Defense: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: ~$2 round-trip commission on a $65 position is ~3.1% drag — TP1 (+7.6% from $12.05) clears it comfortably, TP2 is the real target.

Next step: analyze INFU
#9 — XGN Exagen Inc
⭐⭐⭐ (3/5) Diagnostics SMALL CAP		 $6.87 +4.25%

Signal: Record Q2 results (revenue +16% YoY, guidance raised) reported Aug 4 — gapped from $4.68 to $6.45, still grinding higher 3 trading days later, +4.25% Fri Aug 7.

Why it's interesting: Autoimmune/rheumatic diagnostic testing (AVISE brand) bouncing off a badly beaten-down base — still 44% below its $12.23 52-week high, so this reads more as a recovery bounce than a fresh breakout. Higher risk: thin, volatile microcap (~$3.16M avg $ volume, 52-week range $2.59–$12.23).

Realistic target: +8-21% over 5-10 trading days toward the 13-week high.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $6.55–6.65 — let the week's gains cool before entering a name this volatile.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $6.60 · stop-limit trigger $6.35 / limit $6.25 (below the Aug 5-6 $6.39-6.46 shelf) · TP1 sell limit $7.10 · TP2 $8.00 · size ~9.80 sh ≈ $64.68 (15% of $431.56) · R:R ≈ 1.4:1 to TP1, ≈4.0:1 to TP2

Event window: Earnings already behind it ✅  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — autoimmune diagnostic testing labs  |  Defense: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: Thinnest liquidity on this list. ~$2 commission on $65 is ~3.1% drag — fine against these targets, but size down further if IBKR shows a wide spread at entry time.

Next step: analyze XGN

Cut this run — showing the work

SG (Sweetgreen) — FADED vs IBKR: search flagged a bullish call sweep, but live price is down 8.18% on the day, well off highs. Search narrative already stale.
CAT (Caterpillar) — FADED vs IBKR: "surged 8%" narrative contradicted by live data — down 1.62% today, 21% off its 52-week high.
MSFT — STALE: Azure beat-and-raise gap has stalled, flat (−0.10%) on Friday with no fresh confirmation.
MANH (Manhattan Associates) — STALE: catalyst was Jul 29, 8 trading days old, outside the 5-day freshness window, though still drifting up modestly.
INSP (Inspire Medical) — technical damage too deep: +21% earnings beat, but stock is still 59% below its 52-week high — an earnings pop inside a severe downtrend, not a clean momentum setup.
ELF (e.l.f. Beauty) — weaker edge: Aug 5 analyst upgrade, single source, still 35% off its 52-week high — a bounce, not yet leadership.
APPS (Digital Turbine) — stalled: earnings pop has gone flat (+0.21%), no fresh push to confirm.
CRL (Charles River Labs) & AMGN — both genuinely fine (at/near 52-week highs) but bumped from the top 9 on list-size discipline; honorable mentions if you want a look.
TSAT (Telesat) — HARD EXCLUDE: this week's specific catalyst is a C$2.7B Canadian military Arctic satcom contract. Textbook defense-contract-driven move.
PLTR (Palantir) — HARD EXCLUDE: core business runs substantially through DoD/intelligence contracts (Gotham platform); defense exposure is central, not incidental.
KTOS (Kratos Defense) — HARD EXCLUDE: explicit defense/military contractor.
PAY (Paysafe) — halal trap: meaningful revenue from online-gambling payment processing (Skrill/NETELLER merchant base).
HUM (Humana) & BRK-B (Berkshire) — haram: primary/major segment is conventional insurance.
UPST (Upstart) — haram: AI lending marketplace, core business is interest-based loan origination.
IMC (IMC Rare Earths) — too thin: IPO'd July 29, no reliable liquidity track record yet.
Materials momentum names (Aspen Aerogels, Flotek, Kaiser Aluminum, Koppers, Materion, Myers, Nucor, Perimeter Solutions, Steel Dynamics), plus NET, TWLO, FROG, MCHP, AKAM, ETSY, IR, ADM, AEIS, CEG — generic sector-momentum mentions with no concrete, dated, company-specific catalyst confirmed fresh this week.

🏆 Today's best setup

TEAM — Atlassian

Biggest, freshest beat-and-raise of the week (+35.7%, 1 trading day old) with the most room left of any name on this list — still 18.7% below its 52-week high even after the pop, versus ABNB which gapped straight into its own ceiling. $762M avg daily volume means exit liquidity is never the constraint. Fresher and stronger than the mega-cap pack (MSFT/INTC have already stalled or are further from their highs) because the earnings risk just resolved and the market hasn't finished pricing in the raise yet.

Invalidation: A close back below $140.50 (Friday's $141.51 session low) says the gap failed to hold — exit, don't average down.

Research output, not financial advice. Every price/volume figure sourced live from IBKR at scan time (Fri Aug 7 close, most recent session).
